Method of Attack: Displays a fake student survey to trick high school students into entering email and password, then shows a ransomware message demanding $10 USD in bitcoins
Pretends to encrypt files but currently does not encrypt them (in-development ransomware)
Discoverer: Unspecified researcher who contacted the J. Sterling Morton school district
Impacted Systems: Computers used by high school students in the J. Sterling Morton school district, Cicero, Illinois
Attack Vector: Social engineering via fake student survey interface
